parameters.content:
## WF2 - Human approval gate (plan section 17)

Triggered by WF1 (Execute Workflow) with a single input, `case_id`. Can also
be triggered directly (Execute Workflow Trigger supports manual runs) to
re-send an approval request for a case that is already sitting in
human_review -- useful after a 24h timeout re-notify.

Before requesting approval this workflow calls `POST
/cases/{id}/post-for-review`. Two real states land here with the same
disposition (see tests/api/test_api.py: negative_control reaches
human_review directly; cert_expired reaches reasoned and needs an explicit
post-for-review first) -- rather than branch on which one, this workflow
always calls post-for-review and treats a 409 (already in human_review,
an illegal no-op transition) as success, not failure. See the IF node
below.

desk/api.py never auto-approves. If Gmail's Send and Wait times out with no
response, this workflow escalates and re-notifies -- it does not treat
silence as approval. (n8n issue #25311 documented a Teams send-and-wait
auto-approving without interaction; Gmail is used here specifically to
avoid that class of bug, and the `respondedAt` field from the wait node's
output is asserted present before any decision is accepted -- see the Code
node near the end.)

nodes.name: IF not-409 (either transitioned or already illegal-for-a-real-reason)

parameters.content:
200 -- transitioned reasoned -> human_review, proceed.
409 with 'already in human_review' -- this workflow's own
post-for-review call is a defensive no-op for cases like
negative_control that land in human_review directly; proceed anyway.
Any other 409 (e.g. called on a case still in verifying) is a real
bug in what triggered this workflow -- surfaced via the false branch
below rather than silently swallowed.

parameters.subject: =Assertion Desk: case {{ $('When called by WF1').item.json.case_id }} needs review

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "approver": $json.data.approvedBy || $env.DESK_ANALYST_ALIAS, "decision": $json.data.approved ? "approved" : "escalated", "channel": "gmail", "override_reason": $json.data.approved ? undefined : ($json.data.comment || "rejected via Gmail send-and-wait, no comment supplied") } }}

parameters.content:
override_reason is only sent on reject/escalate -- desk/api.py's own
test suite (test_decision_escalated_requires_override_reason) makes it
mandatory exactly there and rejects it as a 400 if missing on an
approved decision path is a non-issue since the field is simply absent.
This is the free-text override reason plan section 17 calls out as
feeding the human-override-rate metric.

parameters.subject: =Assertion Desk: case {{ $('When called by WF1').item.json.case_id }} approval timed out (24h)
parameters.message:
=No response within 24 hours to the review request for case {{ $('When called by WF1').item.json.case_id }}. desk/api.py never auto-approves on timeout (plan section 21) -- this case is being escalated and re-notified rather than silently published.

Case detail: {{ $env.DESK_API_BASE_URL || 'http://app:5050' }}/cases/{{ $('When called by WF1').item.json.case_id }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "approver": "system:timeout", "decision": "escalated", "channel": "gmail", "override_reason": "no analyst response within 24h -- auto-escalated, not auto-approved" } }}
